name: Three channels
description: A stack of three books with plum, violet and lavender covers lies with rounded spines to the left, and the edge of each page block is a miniature piano keyboard with one key lit lime, climbing from book to book like a chord.
choices: The synth player’s one-keyboard-per-channel strips become a stack of books: white pages read as white keys
Lavender, violet and plum on the covers; lime only on the sounding keys, as on the original displays
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
